summary: Star Gold Corp. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026 (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) disclosing a press release and technical report summary for an updated S-K 1300 Preliminary Economic Assessment of its 100%-controlled Longstreet Gold-Silver Project in Nye County, Nevada. Prepared by Kappes, Cassiday Associates, the study models a conventional open-pit crushed heap-leach operation at 5,500 tpd with a 0.8:1 strip ratio. Base-case economics at $3,600/oz gold and $48/oz silver show pre-tax NPV5 of $87 million, 48% IRR, and 1.7-year payback. This is a routine technical disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics apply. Watch for subsequent development or financing announcements that could convert the study into actionable corporate events.
